name: Texture Uniting (Multi-Channel Packing)
definition: A technique to combine four separate 3D textures (noise, detail, light, mask) into a single RGBA 3D texture to optimize memory bandwidth and sampling, using linear clamping sampling to handle resolution differences.
summary: Texture Uniting packs four 3D textures into one RGBA volume to optimize memory bandwidth and sampling, unlike spatial atlases that minimize binding switches.
